previous_candidate_checks.note: These are earlier candidate receipts, not reruns against the final package. All production source except the objectives screen is byte-identical; final-package checks cover that screen and the extended combat paths.

gpu_component_checks.note: Forward+ and GL component evidence from the earlier equipment/spell candidate. Referenced terrain, water, camera and model sources remain byte-identical. Later changes are confined to item-range setup, story visibility recovery and the objectives UI.

combat_range.runtime_cases: Short and long bows; moving and stationary targets; targets beyond range; repeated shooting; every melee category; all weapon database ranges for NPC and party stats; weapon swaps, empty slots, late-join records and legacy saves; ordinary and natural AI spell ranges; party target and point spells with and without rune modifiers.
combat_range.scope_limit: Prepared noticed targets and issued attack/cast orders, not a complete campaign playthrough or broad AI-perception evaluation.

location_description.coverage: Complete native text; clipping within frame; actual GUI wheel dispatch; drag to end; held original arrows; independent quest scrolling; zone-change reset; no bar when text fits.

lovkach.recovery: Schedules the validated original VCheck gate on revisits and legacy hidden saves. Does not grant rewards, mutate quest flags, duplicate pending scripts, resurrect dead actors, recreate removed actors or apply to modified script bodies.
lovkach.scope_limit: Original scripts and prepared persisted state, not an inspection of the player save.

snow.note: The GL driver already clamped the old high-gradient sampling. The new sampler and shared-edge checks pass in both renderers.

reflections.note: Controlled terrain atlas sampling reproduces bright color bleed; original Ingos water is checked from six viewpoints. The higher Mirror resolution has a GPU cost.

spells.coverage: Shop-only, bag-only and mixed runes; state before success acknowledgement; completed spell shown in bag; disassembly; stale and duplicate requests; two real local ENet peers, private purses and paused co-op.

equipment.scope: Brissen native enchanted armor; unique sale and exact buyback; old generated variants; authored texture layers and localized titles; material, wear, charge and enchantment preservation; all 19 lesovik clan variants.

localization.rule: AGENTS.md requires every visible string in EN, RU and DE, including dynamic keys and generated descriptions.

limits: Linux x86-64 and Chromium were run locally. Windows, macOS and Android were exported and structurally audited; those operating systems/devices were not runtime-tested in this release pass.
macOS is an unsigned universal app using the stock engine and script fallbacks; Linux, Windows and Android retain the existing patched engine templates.
The exact castle-in-lake screenshot view was not reproduced. Terrain cracks were reproduced on original Ingos assets without HD Lands, so that defect is not specific to HD Lands.
Prepared combat/quest state and local co-op tests do not constitute a full campaign playthrough or wide-area multiplayer test.
Tests use owned original data and isolated XDG/browser profiles. Original data, normal saves, private keys and third-party mod assets are not bundled.
